description: Ex-US Navy SH-3D (c/n 61-397, BuNo 154107) taken on by the Brazilian Navy in 1996 as N-3018 and placed on display at the Navy's waterfront cultural centre on 30 Oct 2005 (aerialvisuals dossier); listed by pt.wikipedia as 'um helicóptero da Aviação Naval'.

A Brazilian Navy A-4 Skyhawk (AF-1) is reported beside the Sea King at the Espaço Cultural da Marinha by the aerialvisuals Locator (undated, no serial); not confirmed by another source - verify on site.
